purpose: A dialog card over a scrim that interrupts the flow for a decision or a short task, such as a confirmation or a small form. It holds a header, a content slot and a footer.

notFor.case: A notification that should not block the page.
A message that stays on the page.
A long task or a panel beside the page.
A small floating panel attached to its trigger.

Open.meaning: The app opens it; it takes focus and makes the page inert.
Open.visual: Surface/overlay scrim behind the card. simple: Surface/layer-2 card with a Border/default edge. tray: a Surface/layer-1 shell around a Surface/layer-2 panel (Border/subtle dividers), footer on the tray. Enters with dialog-enter.

Closed.meaning: Closed by the app, or by the person with Escape, the scrim or the close button; focus returns to the trigger.

a11y.role: dialog with aria-modal="true", labelled by the title and described by the description
a11y.keyboard: Focus moves into the dialog on open and is trapped: Tab / Shift+Tab cycle inside. Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger (Radix Dialog).
a11y.reducedMotion: dialog-enter and dialog-exit collapse to a fade of the scrim and the card (their reduced versions in src/lib/motion.ts).
notes: Never hide the title: it is the dialog's name.

openQuestions: The Storybook control Layout differs from the contract axis (tray · simple). Which one is right? (finding PAR-001 Modal story/Layout)
Layout simple is the default "for now". Which layout becomes the default?
